faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Child Development Project Office Poshan Beerwah (CDPO Poshan Beerwah) for filling various positions in Jammu and Kashmir.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised under CDPO Poshan Beerwah Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Sanginis (Anganwadi Workers) under advertisement number 03 of 2026.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for the Sanginis (Anganwadi Workers) post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for CDPO Poshan Beerwah Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it out, and submit it by post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed offline application form is 15-10-2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for Sanginis (Anganwadi Workers)?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Sanginis (Anganwadi Workers) post must possess a qualification of 10+2 to Graduation depending on the specific requirements.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for CDPO Poshan Beerwah Sanginis Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is minimum 18 years and maximum 37 years, with age calculated as on 01-01-2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General, OBC, SC, and ST categories for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for CDPO Poshan Beerwah Sanginis Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process includes preparation of a Merit List followed by Document Verification of eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF and application form?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF and application form by visiting the important links section provided in this article.
